name: smtp-dev-server
free_limit: Free BSD-3-Clause local SMTP capture server for macOS and Linux with a browser UI; retains up to 500 messages by default (configurable with -max-messages), with no provider-imposed subscription or expiry.
watch_out: Development/testing only: accepts arbitrary SMTP AUTH credentials, binds to localhost by default, and does not deliver real email. Messages are stored locally; do not expose its SMTP/UI ports publicly. Hosting and storage are user-provided; this is a distinct Go implementation inspired by smtp4dev.
